name: new-react-navigation
title: Create Navigation
description: Create an accessible navigation component from unique ID, name, and destination rows. Add an optional grid and class name.

settings.name: name
settings.title: Navigation Name
settings.description: Navigation name in any text style; generated folders and files use PascalCase.

settings.name: title
settings.title: Title
settings.description: Optional display title for the generated React navigation component; defaults to its name.

settings.name: description
settings.title: Description
settings.description: Optional description for the generated React navigation component.

settings.name: rows
settings.title: Navigation Rows
settings.description: Required nonempty array of unique {id, name, path} records.

settings.name: grid
settings.title: Grid
settings.description: Optional canonical grid layout; adds data-grid.

settings.name: class_name
settings.title: Container Class
settings.description: Optional class string appended to the base class.

settings.name: save_as_text
settings.title: Save As Text
settings.description: Write component source with a .txt extension.
